description.value: Mountain View Liquor Store is an independent off-sales retailer on Fraser Street in Vancouver carrying over 1,000 products spanning wine, craft beer, spirits, coolers, cider, and a small selection of non-alcoholic soft drinks. The shop operates an online catalogue through SwypePOS, suggesting a modern, well-organised inventory. It sits in the Mount Pleasant–Fraserhood corridor, a neighbourhood increasingly popular with cyclists commuting and touring through south Vancouver.
